\section{Kernel Only}
\label{sec:k}

No amsmath and no natbib here: the kernel adapters run instead. A kernel
citation \cite{knuth1984texbook}, then math through the kernel
\texttt{\char`\\@eqnnum} path:
\begin{equation}\label{eq:k} y=x^2 \end{equation}
\begin{equation} z=w \end{equation}
\begin{eqnarray} a&=&b \nonumber\\ c&=&d \end{eqnarray}
Unnumbered: \[ q=0 \]

\begin{thebibliography}{9}
\bibitem{knuth1984texbook} D.~E. Knuth, \emph{The TeXbook}, 1984.
\end{thebibliography}
